title: Oracle source configuration
statement: Given a finite Boolean oracle Turing machine $M$ with $k$ ordinary work tapes and a finite Boolean Turing machine $C$ with $c$ work tapes, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $u$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$ (including its query tape), and let $s\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. The oracle source configuration associated to $M,C,u,s$ is a configuration on input $x$ for a machine with $(k+2)+(c+1)+1$ work tapes and state set $M.\mathrm{State}\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, obtained by embedding the shadow of $u$ on side $s$, with all auxiliary tapes blank, their heads at position $0$, and the output empty.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean oracle Turing machine
$C$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
